decision: Project existing records instead of creating state
why: The card and canonical orchestration store make this adapter a read-only viewer
result: Plain canonical TSV readers with explicit source health

decision: Separate requirement acceptance from artifact evidence
why: Recovered artifacts and worker completion cannot independently accept requirements
result: Overall done is evidence-linked and source-health gated

decision: Use Node HTTP on ephemeral localhost
why: Node is available, Bun is not, and port zero avoids live service conflicts
result: Server binds 127.0.0.1 and reports selected port

decision: Use native session observations without model calls
why: session.list supplies current liveness and bounded history supplies terminal reason
result: Running, completed, error, and unknown remain distinct

decision: Generate CORDIS-INDEX-01 workbook from independent manifest
why: Every new TypeScript and JavaScript source must be reviewably enumerated
